data: NVIDIA reported fiscal 2023 revenue (year ended January 29, 2023) of $26,974 million, essentially flat against $26,914 million in fiscal 2022, which works out to growth of about 0.2%, or roughly $60 million. Net income fell sharply to $4,368 million from $9,752 million the year before, a decline of about 55%. The drop came mainly from a lower gross profit ($15,356 million versus $17,475 million), higher operating expenses including a $1,353 million acquisition termination cost, and diluted earnings per share of $1.74 versus $3.85. An income tax benefit of $187 million partly cushioned the result.
